input.quote: Commerce One warrants that the Software and MarketSite.net Service will perform in substantial accordance with the Documentation, and the media on which the Software is distributed will be free from defects in materials and workmanship under normal use, for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period").
input.rationale: Section 7.3 gives a real conformance-to-Documentation warranty plus a no-malicious-code warranty, and Section 7.3/7.4 remedies (correction, replacement, and refund of prepaid fees on termination) satisfy the repair/replace/refund requirement; the implied-warranty disclaimer (p0084) does not purport to override these express warranties. The failing material term is duration: sixty (60) days measured from the Effective Date, with an absolute cut-off of December 31, 1999, is below the 90-day software fallback, and because Acceptance Testing may itself run to December 31, 1999 under Section 3.1, the warranty could lapse at or before acceptance — leaving effectively no conformance warranty. Section 11.2 (post-Warranty-Period spec compliance as a material condition) and the maintenance obligations in Section 5.3 mitigate but do not supply a warranty remedy. We therefore propose 12 months from acceptance (preferred), with 90 days from acceptance as our fallback. Absence of a professional-and-workmanlike standard for the professional/support services is noted but not separately flagged.

ops.oldText: for a period of sixty (60) days from the Effective Date, but in no event not later than December 31, 1999 (the "Warranty Period")
ops.newText: for a period of twelve (12) months from Corio's acceptance of the Software pursuant to Section 3.1 (the "Warranty Period")

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the product warranty to twelve (12) months running from acceptance and removed the December 31, 1999 sunset, since a 60-day period measured from the Effective Date can expire before Acceptance Testing is even complete. Our playbook position is 12 months for software (90 days from acceptance would be our fallback).
proposal.summary: Extend software/service warranty period to 12 months from acceptance and delete the fixed 1999 expiry date.
